<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: SEO Lab - Robots Rules
 * Description: Contains one accidental and one intentional noindex rule.
 */
function seo_lab_robots_rules_output() {
    if (is_page('field-notes') || is_page('private-reference')) {
        echo '<meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow" data-seo-lab="noindex-rule">';
    }
}
add_action('wp_head', 'seo_lab_robots_rules_output', 20);
